email.subject: Quick fix for Gearhead's website
email.body:
Hi Luis,

I checked Gearhead Auto Care's site. Two things are likely costing you customers: it isn't mobile-friendly, and there's no click-to-call button, so people searching for auto repair on their phones can't easily reach you. The site also has no reviews shown, which makes new visitors less sure about choosing you over another shop.

I fix sites like this for a flat fee. Want a free 10-minute walkthrough where I show you exactly what's happening and what it'd take to fix?

Alex
Northlight Web
